description:
iCOMPLY contract: pairwise prediction with provenance fields.

Returns the engine's predicted winner + probability shaped so
iCOMPLY's Annex IV section-4 generator can ingest the response
directly. See [iCOMPLY_INTEGRATION_STRATEGY.md] for the contract.

api_key is optional on the public endpoint; on /mcp/mcp a missing
key is refused.
name: aimrank_predict
